name: Specialized S-Works Crux frameset
why_interesting: The premium S-Works frameset anchors the top of the Crux build-your-own range with an official mainland catalog price.
missing: Exact current generation, color and included hardware
Current mainland stock and final dealer checkout
price_status: Official mainland CNY 33,990 catalog observation for the represented prior-generation FACT 12r frameset; stock and final checkout untested

facts.frame: S-Works Crux FACT 12r carbon, threaded bottom bracket, UDH
facts.frame_weight_basis: Exact manufacturer frame-only claim for FACT 12r product 223486; a separate size-56 painted frameset-system value is 1.46 kg and actual weights vary by color, size and components
facts.stiffness_evidence: Exact prior-generation independent comparison review describes a stiff frame, very responsive behavior and precise steering; qualitative ride evidence, not an instrumented frame-deflection test

source_note: Exact product 223486 supports the frame weights, while an independent prior-generation review supports qualitative stiffness and responsiveness. The CNY 33,990 China catalog observation remains distinct from the newer Crux 5.
